data.notes: May 2027 in Malta is already anchored by a run of fly-in electronic festivals spanning house, techno, trance, hard techno and drum & bass, with several lineups still TBA.

events.title: Rong Open Air Festival Malta 2027
events.venueName: Multiple venues: Café del Mar, Little Armier Beach, UNO Malta and boat parties
events.summary: Four-day trance festival across six Malta venues, including open-air club events, sunset, beach and boat parties. Confirmed artists include Paul van Dyk, Ferry Corsten, Aly & Fila, Markus Schulz, Ben Hemsley, Chicane, Giuseppe Ottaviani and many more.

events.title: XXL Malta Festival 2027
events.summary: Teletech and The Warehouse Project’s hard-techno island takeover returns for another Malta edition across multiple venues, including beach and heritage-site style settings.

events.title: XXL Malta 2027
events.summary: The Warehouse Project and Teletech-associated hard-techno festival returns to Malta for its fourth edition. The 2027 lineup and final venues are still to be announced, but the dates are confirmed.

events.title: WAH Malta 2027
events.venueName: UNO Malta, Little Armier Beach and Sliema boat parties
events.summary: Worried About Henry’s Malta edition returns with four days of heavyweight drum & bass programming across open-air arenas, beach sessions and boat parties.

events.title: Sunny Side Festival 2027
events.summary: Boutique underground house and techno gathering scheduled for five days at Ta' Qali Craft Village, with a 2027 lineup still to be announced.

events.title: Higher Love Malta 2027
events.summary: A week-long house-led Malta festival from the LoveJuice/Higher Love camp, with general admission, VIP and group packages confirmed for 28 April–4 May 2027.

events.title: Euphoria Weekender Malta 2027
events.summary: Week-long trance and hard-trance gathering at Gianpula Village and other Malta locations. Confirmed names include Lange, Ian Van Dahl, Rob Tissera, Roger Shah, Agnelli & Nelson, XiJaro & Pitch, Darren Tate and Maria Healy.

events.title: Euphoria Malta 2027
events.summary: An intimate week-long trance rave holiday with extended sets, new venues and a limited-capacity community feel, running from 26 May to 1 June 2027.
